mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy, which reduces discount rates for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.05% over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: Weak labor market conditions, indicated by nonfarm payrolls growth below 0.5% over the prior three months, signal economic slowdown and lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth (3mo) is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Joint growth in housing starts and real personal consumption expenditures signals robust consumer demand, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through increased corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term is statistically insignificant (p>0.05) in a regression model.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in industrial production exceeding 0.5% over one month signals an impending economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion periods, INDPRO declines exceeding 0.5% in one month do not result in negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Rising consumer price inflation, indicated by CPIAUCSL increasing above 0.2% month-over-month, signals a healthy economy and moderate inflation, which supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises by at least 0.2% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 600,000 units per month signal strong residential construction activity, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through increased economic activity and consumer confidence.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST exceeds 600.0.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between strong labor market growth (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% over three months) and accommodative monetary policy (FEDFUNDS <= 0.25%) signals a positive economic environment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: labor market strength with accommodative monetary policy
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS growth > 0.5% and FEDFUNDS <= 0.25% fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term is statistically insignificant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a post-recession recovery regime, a rise in real personal consumption expenditures exceeding 0.5% over one month signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In post-recession recovery periods, RSAFS growth exceeding 0.5% in one month does not lead to positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases.
